payload.text: {"summary":"Drafted apps/lp-manager/openapi.yaml — an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec for the CryptoPanic v2 news API (the news/insight platform chosen in the clarify step). CryptoPanic's docs pages are Cloudflare-blocked and client-rendered, so the reference was extracted from the doc templates embedded in CryptoPanic's own JS app bundle (static.cryptopanic.com), cross-checked against the kukapay cryptopanic-mcp-server client and web search results. The spec covers the two endpoints the lp-manager user story needs: GET /posts/ (headline feed with 15 query params: currencies for per-token filtering, filter=hot/rising/bullish/bearish/important, kind, regions, public/following modes, and the Enterprise trending surface panic_score/panic_period/panic_sort plus search/size/page/with_content/last_pull) and GET /status/ (key usage/quota). Response schemas: PostsPage, Post, Instrument, NewsSource, Votes, ArticleContent, ApiUsage. Auth is the auth_token query key, declared both as a securityScheme and as an explicit required parameter on every operation so progenitor codegen picks it up; the server URL embeds the {api_plan} segment (developer|growth|enterprise) as a server variable. Enums are confined to query parameters and the NewsSource.type field is a plain string to avoid progenitor enum-name collisions. Skipped /portfolio/ and the RSS format variant as out of scope. Validated: YAML parses, all $refs resolve, every operation has operationId and a 200 response with schema; provenance recorded in openapi.meta.json (endpoints_specced=2, endpoints_skipped=2).","artifacts":"apps/lp-manager/openapi.yaml, apps/lp-manager/openapi.meta.json","followUps":"Next: aomi-build gen-client cryptopanic (app-local mode against apps/lp-manager/). Note the free 'developer' plan is discontinued April 1st 2026 — lp-manager should default the base URL plan segment to a paid plan and treat Enterprise-only params (panic_sort trending, search, with_content) as optional capabilities that 403 on lower plans. Instrument price/market-cap field nullability was inferred, not documented — verify against a live authenticated response once an API key is available."}
